raw_html: [[Corrosive Salt Guard|Corrosive Salt Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Corrosive Salt Guard]]:''' This item stores a caustic, insatiable power deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power can come to the surface in the form of a noxious, corrosive salt that dissolves all substances.
